# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

This fork automatically builds only the unsigned Intel Mac x64 DMG through [macos-package-intel.yml](workflows/macos-package-intel.yml) on master pushes, manual dispatch, and published Releases. Download the DMG from Actions Artifacts or the triggering Release. Other workflows do not run on master pushes; the upstream CI topology described below remains available for explicit checks. Do not restore automatic multi-platform builds without a user request.

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows pull-request jobs live in `ci-windows.yml` and Python pull-request jobs in `ci-python.yml`, so each PR workflow can be re-run independently; their checks feed the required `windows checks passed` and `python checks passed` verdicts, as Linux jobs in `ci.yml` feed `all checks passed`; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Python runtime CI checks Linux/Windows x64 on pull requests; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](workflows/ci-master.yml)). `ci.yml`, `ci-windows.yml`, and `ci-python.yml` are pull-request-only. Master-only platform checks, Linux/Windows self-hosted standbys, and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which in this fork listens only to `workflow_dispatch`, not `pull_request`; separating workflow triggers keeps master-only jobs out of PR check panels. The master standbys validate the self-hosted failover targets; preserve the existing per-platform switches (values `selfhosted` for the in-house standbys and `blacksmith` for Blacksmith's hosted runners) and the Dependabot hosted fallback under the `selfhosted` values ([failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md), [blacksmith failover leg note](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-09-blacksmith-failover-leg.md)).

The manual [Windows packaging workflow](workflows/windows-package.yml) uses the dedicated self-hosted Windows x64 label `dsh-win-package-trial` under native `pwsh`; preserve this routing separately from the automatic CI lanes.

The manual Desktop publication workflow selects a successful package run and attempt, then routes each retained build through `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS` to its original machine's unique label. Keep Windows run steps on native PowerShell and Mac run steps on the default POSIX shell; shared entrypoints are Node scripts. Test and production jobs use separate `desktop-test` and `desktop-production` approval Environments after a credential-free preparation job.
